= AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS)
:artifactid: camel-aws2-ecs-starter

Create, describe, list and delete clusters of AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS).

== What's inside

* xref:{csb-camel-components}::aws2-ecs-component.adoc[AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS) component], URI syntax: `aws2-ecs:label`

Please refer to the above links for usage and configuration details.

<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.camel.springboot</groupId>
    <artifactId>camel-aws2-ecs-starter</artifactId>
</dependency>
